deadline.value: Applications are accepted through January with the faculty admissions meeting in late January; the page gives no exact date.
deadline.quote: Graduate applications to the Dept. of Atmospheric Sciences at the University of Utah are accepted through January.

fee_waiver.value: Fees may be waived for some students case by case.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee may be waived for some students on a case-by-case basis.

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is no longer required but may be submitted as supplementary information.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examinations (GRE) revised General Test is no longer required, however GRE revised General Test Scores may be submitted as supplementary information

gre_subject.value: The department does not mention a subject test.

supervisor.value: Students are admitted only where a faculty member's grant can pay their stipend, benefits and tuition; the offer letter names the primary advisor.
supervisor.quote: We do not admit more students in a given admissions cycle than we have allocated funding to support through individual faculty grants.

also.quote: If you are admitted, you will receive an offer letter that lists the name of your primary research advisor

funding.value: The department does not accept students without a guarantee of funding; PhD stipend is at least USD 35,000 a year with no tuition cost.
funding.quote: Because funding is limited and we don't accept students without a guarantee of funding

also.quote: nearly all students are awarded a competitive research assistantship

entry_route.value: Applicants with only a bachelor's degree apply to the master's program and must complete it before the exam that decides PhD admission.
entry_route.quote: We require all incoming graduate students holding Bachelor's Degrees to first complete their Master's Degree

notes: Faculty grant funding limits how many students are admitted each year.
